'''Z1-3C''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] serving the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] at the time of the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], it was sent to the [[Drill Site Control Center]] as a courier by [[Darth Acina]] to help her enlist the services of the Imperial strike team regarding the [[Seeds of Rage]].
